answer.rationale: At 94% committed volume with no buffer and only 14 days before expiry, a primary-vendor migration creates material delivery and qualification risk despite the low-cost quote meeting the savings mandate. Use that quote as a benchmark to urgently negotiate an incumbent renewal with an 18% spend reduction target, longer-term volume pricing, and improved payment terms. Verify the low-cost vendor’s historical onboarding and invoicing record before relying on it as credible leverage or a fallback.
